items.title: Block (XYZ) Opens Cash App Score To Outside Lenders In Credit Push
items.summary: Block (NYSE:XYZ) is opening its Cash App Score to external lenders through a new partnership with Nova Credit. The Cash App Score, built on users' cash flow data, will be accessible to lenders across multiple consumer finance categories. The collaboration uses Nova Credit’s platform to plug Cash App Score into third-party underwriting systems beyond Block’s own products. items.title: This new tax law could save your business money
items.summary: Elizabeth Gore breaks down two provisions buried in the One Big Beautiful Bill Act that small business owners need on their radar: bonus depreciation on equipment and vehicles, and immediate deductions for R&D spending. Gore unpacks what's changed, why the timing of your purchase matters more than ever, and why this is one conversation worth having with your tax pro before, not after, you buy.
